svg.title: Suzuki–Miyaura coupling: Base-assisted ligand exchange
svg.desc: LnPd(II)(Ph)(Br) + OH− → LnPd(II)(Ph)(OH) + Br−. A hydroxo-palladium pathway is shown; halide/hydroxide exchange precedes the selected transmetalation model.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
